original.reason: An automorphism sends P to a Sylow p-subgroup, and normality makes P the unique Sylow p-subgroup by Sylow conjugacy.

judgment.reason: Correctly proves uniqueness of the normal Sylow subgroup and applies it to φ(P).
Complete and correct application of automorphism order preservation, Sylow conjugacy, and normality.
Complete proof that φ(P) is Sylow and that P is unique.
Correctly establishes P as the unique Sylow p-subgroup, hence fixed by every automorphism.
